## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate-cards.mjs` and it passed.
- [ ] New cards have unique ids, a valid track, and `status: "todo"`.
- [ ] Links work, and I set `lastChecked` to today's date for any link I added or checked.
- [ ] I didn't change the ids of existing cards. People's saved progress depends on them.
